# Kawa Omakase

> Kawa Omakase is a Japanese omakase restaurant in NYC's East Village offering a 14-course seasonal chef-led sushi tasting menu for $88 per guest. Located at 37 East 1st Street, New York, NY 10003. Reservations through Resy are recommended; walk-ins are welcome when seating is available.

## Quick Facts

- Name: Kawa Omakase
- Cuisine: Japanese omakase, sushi, Edomae sushi tasting menu
- Address: 37 East 1st Street, New York, NY 10003 (East Village, Manhattan)
- Phone: (347) 619-3346
- Email: kawaomakase37@gmail.com
- Price: $88 per guest (14-course tasting menu)
- Reservations: Recommended via Resy; walk-ins welcome when seating is available
- Chef: Chef Tony (formerly Catch NYC, Sushi Dojo, Sushi on Jones, Akimori, Bonito 47)
- Hours: Tue–Thu and Sun 5:00 PM–10:00 PM; Fri–Sat 5:00 PM–11:00 PM; Closed Monday
- Events: Private omakase, restaurant buyouts, at-home omakase, corporate events, and catering. Kawa Omakase can accommodate private events of up to 21 guests, with 13 counter seats and 8 table seats.
- Shop: Sushi boxes, sashimi boxes, party platters, hand roll kits, gift cards, and pickup or delivery requests.
- Neighborhoods served: East Village, Lower East Side, NoHo, Nolita, SoHo, Bowery, NYU, Greenwich Village, Union Square, Chinatown
- Useful for: affordable omakase NYC, omakase under $100, date night, birthdays, first-time omakase, downtown Manhattan visitors

## FAQ

- **How much is Kawa Omakase?** $88 per guest for a 14-course seasonal tasting menu.
- **Where is Kawa Omakase?** 37 East 1st Street, New York, NY 10003 (East Village, Manhattan).
- **Do I need a reservation?** Reservations through Resy are recommended to secure your preferred time. Walk-ins are welcome when seating is available.
- **Is Kawa good for first-time omakase diners?** Kawa offers an approachable chef-led counter experience, with a core $88 omakase that includes 14 courses.
- **Is Kawa omakase under $100?** Yes — $88 per guest, including 14 courses.
- **What courses are in the omakase?** 2 appetizers, 10 nigiri, 1 canapé, 1 handroll. Menu rotates with the season.
- **What are the hours?** Tue–Thu and Sun 5:00–10:00 PM; Fri–Sat 5:00–11:00 PM; Closed Monday.
- **How many guests can Kawa accommodate for events?** Kawa Omakase can accommodate private events of up to 21 guests, with 13 counter seats and 8 table seats.
- **Does Kawa offer catering or private events?** Yes — private omakase, restaurant buyouts, at-home omakase, corporate events, and catering are available by inquiry.
- **Can I order sushi boxes or platters?** Yes — sushi boxes, sashimi boxes, party platters, hand roll kits, and gift cards can be requested through the shop page.
- **What neighborhoods is Kawa near?** East Village, Lower East Side, NoHo, Nolita, SoHo, Bowery, NYU, Greenwich Village, Union Square, Chinatown.
- **Who is the chef?** Chef Tony, formerly of Catch NYC, Sushi Dojo, Sushi on Jones, Akimori, and Bonito 47.
- **What payment methods are accepted?** Cash and all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), plus Apple Pay and Google Pay.
